name: Morii Kaho
source:
Kaho lives in Osaka (大阪), Osaka and goes to Sasamine Jogakuen (笹峰女学園) where she is a third year student in class D.

She likes to run, is on the track team in her school. She has also participated in the national championship tournament in track. Her family has an okonomiyaki store, and she helps out in cooking.
